title: Evidence bundles cannot cite system-memory runbooks directly
wanted_capability: Allow bbox_bundle_evidence to accept system memory/runbook refs returned by bbox_knowledge, or have bbox_knowledge return bundleable canonical refs for sm-* runbooks, so agents can cite runbook support without substituting a broader knowledge entry.
fallback_used: Addressed by introducing canonical system_memory:<id> entity refs and an inspect/bundle provider for system memories.
notes: During sandbox probe, bbox_knowledge(query="sm-agentic-opening-sequence") returned the intended runbook body, but bbox_inspect_entity("knowledge:sm-agentic-opening-sequence") was not_found and bbox_bundle_evidence therefore could not include the runbook as an entity. Implemented EntityType::SystemMemory plus SystemMemoryProvider; bbox_knowledge now advertises ref: system_memory:<id> in exact/listing/signpost/catalog surfaces. Validated with unit tests for parse round-trip, provider registry, inspect, catalog refs, and bundle_evidence. Live dev MCP smoke on 2026-06-05: bbox_knowledge returned ref: system_memory:sm-agentic-opening-sequence; bbox_inspect_entity and bbox_bundle_evidence both returned status ok; property_mode=summary compact bundling returned degraded.property_mode=summary.
